name: Uruka Takemoto
source:
Uruka is an athletic girl and excellent in sports, especially swimming. However, she is appalling in all academic subjects, and very reluctant to study. Once she is studying difficult topics, she burns out easily.

She is a very friendly and outgoing person who has a good relationship with everyone around her, making new friends with ease. She is not afraid to openly express her feelings towards something or someone, which often makes hard for Nariyuki to understand her.

She is good at housework, but she tries to keep it as a secret to everyone.
She has been in love with Nariyuki since middle school.

[Edited from [url=https://weneverlearn.fandom.com/wiki/Uruka_Takemoto]We Never Learn Wiki[/url]]
